data.title: Imagine Learning and AIM Institute Collaborate to Advance Research-Informed Literacy Instruction
data.description: In Tempe, Arizona, Imagine Learning has announced a collaboration with the AIM Institute for Learning & Research to support educators in adapting to changing literacy requirements. With states reinforcing literacy standards and schools focusing on implementing effective reading instruction, educators are facing new research, legislative mandates, and higher performance standards for students. This partnership aims to provide guidance as educators navigate these challenges.

data.title: Nirrin Technologies Showcases Next-Generation Bioprocess Analytical Platform and Workflows at BPI Conference and Exhibition
data.description: Nirrin Technologies, based in Billerica, Massachusetts, will be presenting its transformative bioprocessing tools at the upcoming BPI Conference & Exhibition in Boston. The company's Tunable Laser Near-Infrared (TL-NIR) platform will be on display at Booth #831 from September 22 to 25. This platform integrates a shared hardware base with software-driven analytical processes, offering features like the TALOS™ rapid protein quantitation and ATLAS® multi-analyte quantitation. data.title: Survey: 99% of CX Organizations Use Automation, But Only 24% Say It Delivers ‘Very Positive’ Customer Experiences
data.description: A report by CallMiner, a CX automation leader based in Waltham, Massachusetts, in collaboration with Vanson Bourne, highlighted a notable disparity in organizations' capabilities regarding automation deployment and leveraging customer insights for ongoing enhancements. The annual CX Landscape Report unveiled the integration of automation and AI in customer experience strategies as companies strive to handle the increasing volume of interactions efficiently. This indicates a crucial gap in harnessing customer data effectively for improving automation processes.

data.title: Two Powerhouses, One Drive: SharkNinja Joins McLaren Racing as Official Partner
data.description: A partnership has been formed between SharkNinja, Inc. and McLaren Racing, the well-known British motorsport team, covering Formula 1, IndyCar, World Endurance Championship, and F1 Academy. SharkNinja, listed on NYSE as SN, is a leading global product design and tech company. The collaboration makes SharkNinja an Official Partner of McLaren Racing, offering fans exclusive experiences, content, and activations to engage with the team's ethos and innovation.

data.title: Acclaro Appoints Sahil Rishi Group President to Accelerate its Content Intelligence Strategy
data.description: In Boston, Acclaro, a company specializing in content intelligence solutions for effective global communication, has appointed Sahil Rishi as the new Group President. This top executive will report directly to the Board and will lead the company in its enhanced focus on content intelligence. Acclaro aims to leverage AI technology and human proficiency to provide impactful communication strategies. Rishi's immediate appointment signifies the company's dedication to advancing in this field.

data.title: Centauri Health Solutions Acquires Benny the Benefits Navigator, Expands Capabilities
data.description: A health information technology company in Tempe, Arizona, Centauri Health Solutions, has recently acquired Benny the Benefits Navigator (Benny), a technology company based in Iowa. This acquisition aims to bolster Centauri's disability eligibility solution, Member Connect, by incorporating Benny's platform which focuses on simplifying the application process for public benefits, particularly Supplemental Security Income (SSI) and Social Security Disability Insurance (SSDI). The deal marks a strategic move to improve efficiency in accessing these benefits for individuals.

data.title: Cheetah Net Supply Chain Service Inc. Enters into Agreement to Acquire JoyPak Supply LLC
data.description: Cheetah Net Supply Chain Service Inc. based in Irvine, California, disclosed on September 15, 2026, that they have signed a Membership Interest Purchase Agreement to buy out JoyPak Supply LLC completely. The company, listed on Nasdaq CM as CTNT, is set to acquire all membership interests of JoyPak, a Nevada-based limited liability company, specializing in the retail of consumer goods, beauty products, personal care items, and various everyday-use products. The deal involves purchasing these interests from two limited liability companies based in Delaware and Texas, acting as the Sellers. This acquisition marks a significant move for Cheetah in expanding its presence in the consumer goods market.

data.title: 3 E Network Highlights Strategic Value of Finnish Market Amid Nordic AI Infrastructure Investment Boom
data.description: The Finnish market is being recognized for its strategic importance within the Nordic region amid a surge in investments in AI infrastructure. The 3E Network has emphasized the significance of Finland, with experts predicting a substantial increase in funding for AI projects in the region. This development underscores Finland's position as a key player in the growing AI sector within the broader Nordic context. The investment boom is expected to attract significant capital, with projections indicating a noteworthy rise in financial allocations for AI initiatives across Finland.

data.title: DIU Selects Defense Unicorns to Accelerate Air Mobility Command OMEN Efforts
data.description: Defense Unicorns, a veteran-owned defense technology company based in San Antonio, launched the UDS Fleet, aimed at aiding commanders and aircrews in deploying, updating, monitoring, and maintaining mission software in challenging environments. The innovative system will provide support across contested, disconnected, and operationally constrained areas. The launch, as of September 15, 2026, marks a significant milestone for the company and its mission to enhance military operations with cutting-edge technology.

data.title: Trusted by Workers Since 1993, SCRUBS® Brings The Original Waterless Cleaning Towel™ to Today's Industrial Buyers
data.description: In a recent update, the entire range of products under the SCRUBS® brand has undergone a comprehensive relabeling process. This initiative aims to streamline the process of selecting the appropriate industrial cleaning product for distributors, facility managers, and workers. The refresh in labeling ensures that the trusted performance, which has been synonymous with SCRUBS® for over three decades, is maintained. The development was announced in OLATHE, Kan., on Sept. 15, 2026. This enhanced labeling is set to provide clear guidance on product selection and maintain the high standards expected from SCRUBS® products.
